name: crawlie-cloud
description: Hosted technical-SEO + GEO (AI-search) site audits from Crawlie Cloud.

interface.longDescription: Crawl and audit whole websites for technical SEO and AI-search (GEO) readiness from your agent: prioritized fixes, broken links, metadata and canonical problems, and report diffs that verify fixes landed. Audits run hosted on Crawlie Cloud — sign in and go, nothing to install. Open source at github.com/spronta/crawlie.
defaultPrompt: Audit this site for technical SEO and GEO issues and give me the top fixes
